title: The Immigrant & Historic Businesses of Silver Lake Food Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to Silver Lake! Silver Lake is known for its hills, hipsters, and incredible restaurants! This walking tour will introduce you to some of the best restaurants in all of Los Angeles.

Arrive ready to eat because this food tour will have plenty of stops!

Over 2-3hrs you'll visit some of SL's best known and unknown foodie destinations. Throughout the walk, you'll learn about the history of the neighborhood and LA. The tour will also pass by a couple painted stairways for the perfect photo!

The tour will cover approximately 2 miles over 2-3hrs. We usually walk a couple stairways and a small hill, so be prepared for a bit of walking as well.

Food items on tour may change based on restaurant availability.
